arxiv-2103-13749.title: Time-like hypersurfaces of prescribed mean extrinsic curvature.
arxiv-2103-13749.creator: Helmut Friedrich
arxiv-2103-13749.description: Abstract The results on the initial boundary value problem for Einstein’s vacuum field equation obtained in [ 7 ] rely on an unusual gauge. One of the defining gauge source functions represents the mean extrinsic curvature of the time-like leaves of a foliation that includes the boundary and covers a neighbourhoood of it.

arxiv-2108-02025.title: High Performance Level-1 and Level-2 BLAS
arxiv-2108-02025.creator: Amit Singh, Cem Bassoy
arxiv-2108-02025.description:
A 2021 arXiv research paper by Amit Singh, Cem Bassoy. 1
Introduction

The introduction of the Basic Linear Algebra Subroutine (BLAS) in the 1970s laid the path to the different libraries to solve the same problem with an improved approach and improved hardware.

arxiv-2111-07136.title: The Tri-Pants Graph of the Twice-Punctured Torus
arxiv-2111-07136.creator: Katherine Betts, Troy Larsen, Jeffrey Utley, Avalon Vanis
arxiv-2111-07136.description: Abstract . We investigate the structure of the tri-pants graph, a simplicial graph introduced by Maloni and Palesi, whose vertices correspond to particular collections of homotopy classes of simple closed curves of the twice-punctured torus, called tri-pants, and whose edges connect two vertices whenever the corresponding pants differ by suitable elementary moves.

arxiv-2112-06187.title: On the 3 3 -adic valuation of the Narayana numbers
arxiv-2112-06187.creator: Russelle Guadalupe
arxiv-2112-06187.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Russelle Guadalupe. We define the Narayana sequence { a n } n ≥ 0 \{a_{n}\}_{n\geq 0} as the one satisfying the linear recurrence relation a n = a n − 1 + a n − 3 a_{n}=a_{n-1}+a_{n-3} for n ≥ 3 n\geq 3 , with initial values a 0 = 0 a_{0}=0 and a 1 = a 2 = 1 a_{1}=a_{2}=1 .

arxiv-2406-15387.title: On Profinite Quandles
arxiv-2406-15387.creator: Alexander W. Byard, Brian Cai, Nathan P. Jones, Lucy H. Vuong, David N. Yetter
arxiv-2406-15387.description: Abstract s We undertake the study of profinite quandles. A quandle ( Q , ⊲ ) (Q,\triangleleft) is a set Q Q with a operation ⊲ \triangleleft that satisfies idempotency, right invertibility, and right self-distributivity axioms. Profinite quandles are inverse limits of inverse systems of finite quandles and are closely related to profinite groups.

arxiv-2407-09769.title: Coronal magnetic field and emission properties of small-scale bright and faint loops in the quiet Sun
arxiv-2407-09769.creator: Maria S. Madjarska, Thomas Wiegelmann, Pascal Démoulin, Klaus Galsgaard
arxiv-2407-09769.description: Abstract Context. The present study provides statistical information on the coronal magnetic field and intensity properties of small-scale bright and faint loops in the quiet Sun. Aims. We aim to quantitatively investigate the morphological and topological properties of the coronal magnetic field in bright and faint small-scale loops, with the former known as coronal bright points (CBPs). Methods.

arxiv-2503-11026.title: MAVFlow: Preserving Paralinguistic Elements with Conditional Flow Matching for Zero-Shot AV2AV Multilingual Translation
arxiv-2503-11026.creator: Sungwoo Cho, Jeongsoo Choi, Sungnyun Kim, Se-Young Yun
arxiv-2503-11026.description: Abstract Despite recent advances in text-to-speech (TTS) models, audio-visual to audio-visual (AV2AV) translation still faces a critical challenge: maintaining speaker consistency between the original and translated vocal and facial features. To address this issue, we propose a conditional flow matching (CFM) zero-shot audio-visual renderer that utilizes strong dual guidance from both audio and visual modalities.

arxiv-2506-19557.title: Probing the electromagnetic dipole moment of the τ \tau lepton in the e + ​ e − → γ ∗ / Z → τ + ​ τ − e^{+}e^{-}\to\gamma^{*}/Z\to\tau^{+}\tau^{-} reaction
arxiv-2506-19557.creator: Peng-Cheng Lu, Zong-Guo Si, Han Zhang
arxiv-2506-19557.description: Abstract High-precision measurements of the lepton’s electromagnetic dipole moments provide a powerful probe for testing the Standard Model. A non-zero value of the τ \tau lepton’s electric(weak) dipole moment ( d τ γ d_{\tau}^{\gamma} , d τ Z d_{\tau}^{Z} ) would serve as a smoking gun of the new physics.

arxiv-2511-15180.title: Singularity formation for the supersonic inward wave of compressible Euler equations with radial symmetry
arxiv-2511-15180.creator: Geng Chen, Faris A. El-Katri, Yanbo Hu, Yannan Shen
arxiv-2511-15180.description: Abstract In this paper, we consider the singularity formation of smooth solutions for the compressible radially symmetric Euler equations. By applying the characteristic method and the invariant domain idea, we show that, for polytropic ideal gases with γ ≥ 3 \gamma\geq 3 , the smooth solution develops a singularity in finite time for a class of initial supersonic inward waves.

arxiv-2512-15389.title: Contact geometry in infinite dimensions
arxiv-2512-15389.creator: Fraser A.K. Sanders
arxiv-2512-15389.description: Abstract . We generalise the theories of cosymplectic, contact, and cocontact manifolds to the infinite-dimensional setting and calculate model examples of time-dependent and dissipative Hamiltonian systems. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 53D10, 37J55, 70H05, 46T05 1. Introduction Symplectic geometry and the theory of Hamiltonian mechanics can be readily extended to infinite dimensions, with some very useful results.

arxiv-2602-23825.title: Local Equivalence Classes of Distance-Hereditary Graphs using Split Decompositions
arxiv-2602-23825.creator: Nicholas Connolly, Shin Nishio, Kae Nemoto
arxiv-2602-23825.description: Abstract Local complement is a graph operation formalized by Bouchet which replaces the neighborhood of a chosen vertex with its edge-complement. This operation induces an equivalence relation on graphs; determining the size of the resulting equivalence classes is a challenging problem in general. Bouchet obtained formulas only for paths and cycles, and brute-force methods are limited to very small graphs.

europmc-pmc2128494.creator: Warren SL, Whipple GH.
europmc-pmc2128494.description: These experiments show that the common laboratory animals are about equally sensitive to the x-ray given over the abdomen. The clinical reaction following a M.L.D. is very similar and the intestinal pathology almost identical. The rat and guinea pig are slightly more sensitive...

pmc-11434284.title: A Silver Modified Nanosheet Self-Assembled Hollow Microsphere with Enhanced Conductivity and Permeability
pmc-11434284.creator: Fangmin Wang, Xue Dong, Yuzhen Zhao, Zemin He, Wenqi Song, Chunsheng Li, Jiayin Li, Jianfeng Huang, Zongcheng Miao, Lei Huang
pmc-11434284.description: The utilization of sheet structure composites as a viable conductive filler has been implemented in polymer-based electromagnetic shielding materials. However, the development of an innovative sheet structure to enhance electromagnetic shielding performance remains a significant challenge. Herein, we propose a novel design incorporating silver-modified nanosheet self-assembled hollow spheres to optimize their performance.

pmc-11728846.title: Advancements and Challenges in the Management of Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis: A Review
pmc-11728846.creator: Francesco Nappi, Deborah Anderson
pmc-11728846.description: Prosthetic valve endocarditis (PVE) is the medical term used to describe a focus of infection involving a valvular substitute within the heart. It is a significant concern in the field of cardiology, and the epidemiology of PVE has seen notable developments over the last five decades.

pmc-12406453.title: Safety and outcome of intravenous thrombolysis in ischemic stroke related to intracranial artery dissection
pmc-12406453.creator: Wen Yang, Jian-Wei Wang, Mei-xia Zhang, Hong-Fang Chen
pmc-12406453.description: BackgroundThe clinical efficacy of intravenous thrombolysis (IVT) for acute ischemic stroke (AIS) associated with intracranial artery dissection (IAD) remains uncertain.Case summaryThis study presents a case of basilar artery dissection (BAD) in a 57-year-old Asian female patient devoid of previous risk factors for stroke who experienced a sudden onset of consciousness disturbance.

pmc-12534378.title: Modelling crop growth and soil hydrothermal regimes under conservation agriculture using APSIM-wheat
pmc-12534378.creator: Brijesh Yadav, Prameela Krishnan, C. M. Parihar, Koushik Banerjee
pmc-12534378.description: With increasing adoption of residue retention over soil surface, there is an urgent need to investigate the effect of residue on soil water moderation and soil temperature distribution during crop growth period. Therefore, an investigation was carried out on wheat crop, grown under long term experiment integrating a dual strategy of field experiment and crop simulation modelling.

pmc-12789549.title: Broadband electromagnetic absorption up to 1473 K enabled by dielectric frequency-dispersion engineering in ceramic composites
pmc-12789549.creator: Bin Ren, Yujun Jia, Lehua Qi, Qiangang Fu, Yixiang Lin, Hang Yu, Junjie Cheng, Mengyu Dai, Qiang Song, Yulei Zhang, Xianghui Hou, Hejun Li
pmc-12789549.description: Rising vehicle Mach numbers urgently necessitate broadband electromagnetic wave (EMW) absorbers capable of operating at even higher temperatures while maintaining environmental durability. However, Current high-temperature EMW absorbing materials face the restriction and temperature-sensitivity of dielectric frequency-dispersion (FD), which often forces reliance on complex macro-structures to broaden effective absorption bandwidth (EAB).

pmc-13087129.title: Contrasting phenological shifts in diurnal and nocturnal Lepidoptera under climate change
pmc-13087129.creator: Anders Forsman, Bafraw Karimi, Markus Franzén
pmc-13087129.description: Phenological shifts enable species to adjust the timing of life-history events to required resources. Climate change alters the spatiotemporal association between temperature and photoperiod, modifying the scope for temperature regulation. Here, we propose a model hypothesizing that dissimilar light requirements and constraints differently impact phenological responses in diurnal versus nocturnal ectotherms.

pmc-13453410.title: Prognostic Value of Ultrasonographic Optic Nerve Sheath Diameter in Patients with Sepsis in the Intensive Care Unit: A Prospective Observational Study
pmc-13453410.creator: Kamuran Uluç, Ahmet Oğuzhan Küçük
pmc-13453410.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundSepsis is a life-threatening condition characterized by organ dysfunction and may involve the central nervous system through blood–brain barrier disruption and increased intracranial pressure. Ultrasonographic optic nerve sheath diameter (ONSD) is a non-invasive surrogate marker of intracranial pressure.
